array of 0x14-byte records written by slot 0x350

notes: Only one class (vtable 0x7104f717a0, constructor f_71004a4a00, destructors f_71004a5020/f_71004a5050). All 2nd_* (rope/hair secondary physics) slots in this class are stubs: setters return, getters return 0, -1 (get_2nd_status), 0.0, or the global zero vector (get_2nd_pos, get_2nd_speed); get_2nd_joint_id returns hash40 0x07fb997a80. So no exported getter returns a module field by plain load: every field is probable. Real methods: reset_swing, set_swing_rate, set_swing_wind, set_swing_only_anim, set_swing_rebirth, set_swing_ground_collision_all, set_swing_special_state (forward to swing controller (+0x20)->+0x68), set_ik*, get_ik_end_joint_id, stop_charge. set_swing_joint_name (slot 0xc0) and update_rope_matrix (slot 0x60) are empty. setup slot 0x28(arg1 {ik_count, ik_array}, arg2 0x35-byte descriptor, arg3 {u64, ptr}) also registers an event listener object (0x28 bytes, vtable 0x7104f71ce8, callback 0x71004a9c30) in the boma's event list (boma+0x18). Gaps not individually named: +0x58..+0x7c (rest of the copied descriptor), +0x84..+0x8f, +0x9c, +0xcf.
